title: Completion of a prime localization under a surjective base change
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings, with R Noetherian and B an R-algebra whose structure map f is surjective. Let Q be a prime ideal of R and q a prime ideal of B with Q = f⁻¹(q). Put A = R_Q and D = B_q, and let Cp and C be their completions at their local maximal ideals. Then C is isomorphic as a B-algebra to B ⊗[R] Cp.

proof.text: The localization map φ : R_Q → B_q is surjective (RingHom.SurjectiveOnStalks.localRingHom_surjective) and has kernel (ker f)R_Q (IsLocalization.ker_map). This is localization of a quotient, after identifying B with R/ker f.

The surjective local-ring map sends the maximal ideal onto the maximal ideal. Apply AdicCompletion.exists_local_completion_quotient to obtain C ≃ Cp/(ker f)Cp and its compatibility with structure maps.

The compatibility makes this an R-algebra equivalence. Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor identifies Cp/(ker f)Cp with (R/ker f) ⊗[R] Cp. Transport the first factor along f.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective to B.
Extend the resulting R-algebra equivalence to a B-algebra equivalence by AlgEquiv.extendScalarsOfSurjective, since f is surjective.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00CT and 00MA (2), (3), combined with tensor-quotient and scalar-extension equivalences

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_surjective_baseChange
    (R : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (hf : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R B))
    (Q : Ideal R) [Q.IsPrime] (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime]
    (hc : Q = q.comap (algebraMap R B)) :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime Q
    let D := Localization.AtPrime q
    let Cp := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D) D
    Nonempty (C ≃ₐ[B] TensorProduct R B Cp)
